描述_EN: it may have been made for use in a tomb, or for the neck support of a living owner. the term cizhou encapsulates a range of wares made in several regions of northern china, often consisting of a course stoneware body covered with a white slip (a thin layer of wet clay), and then decorated with a bold design in a contrasting colour. this pillow is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty (1115-1234). this technique is used to striking effect in creating the features of this ceramic pillow in the shape of a tiger.
描述_ZN: 它可能是为在墓中使用而制作的，也可能是为活着的主人的颈部提供支撑。 这个术语囊括了中国北方几个地区的一系列器物，通常由白色滑液（一层薄薄的湿粘土）覆盖的石器主体组成，然后用对比色的大胆设计进行装饰。 这个枕头是贵州器的一个例子，贵州器是中国北方地区在金代（1115-1234）时制造的一种陶瓷。 这种技术在创造这个老虎形状的陶瓷枕头的特征中被使用到了惊人的效果。
